text:
## [SECTION 1: Ek Anokhi Duty]

Hello doston, mera naam hai Sudhansu aur aap dekh rahe hain Raat 3 Baje. Doston, aaj ki yeh kahani ek aise vanrakshak ke anubhav par aadharit hai jinhone kai saalon tak jungle ki gehraiyon mein seva di. Ek vanrakshak ka jeevan mahan hota hai, lekin ye sirf bahar se hi aisa dikhta hai. Jungle ki khamosh raahein aur uski akadti thand ke beech ek alag tarah ka sannata hota hai jo insaan ko andar se hila deta hai. Jab aap din bhar ki duty ke baad raat ko camp mein baithte hain, toh jungle ki aawazein darr paida karne lagti hain. Iska mahol aur yahan ki mitti ki mehak har kisi ko ek alag ehsaas deti hai. Yeh sirf ped-paudhe nahi hain, balki ek poora sansar hai jisme kai raaz dafan hain. Mere liye yeh kaam sirf ek naukri nahi thi, balki meri zindagi ka ek bada hissa ban gaya tha. Is beech sab kuch bahut hi seedha aur saral lagta tha jab tak ki kuch anokhi ghatinaon ne mera nazariya badal nahi diya. Toh chaliye ab bina waqt zaya kiye aaj ki kahani ko sunte hain. Main aksar logon ko batata tha ki jungle ka apna ek niyam hota hai. Yeh niyam humein kabhi todna nahi chahiye.

Kehte hain ki ghane junglon mein purani yaadein aur aawazein aksar phans jaati hain. Ek waqt tak maine bhi kabhi bhoot-pret in cheezon par yaqeen nahi kiya tha. Par ab, jab main un baaton ko yaad karta hoon, toh mere badan mein ek thandak daud jati hai. Yeh baat kuch saal pehle ki hai jab meri posting Madhya Pradesh ke ek bahut hi door-daaraz ke tiger reserve mein hui thi. Monsoon ka mausam tha aur baarish ne jungle ko ek gehre hare rang se aur mitti ki sondhi khushbu se bhar diya tha. Us waqt mera kaam sirf jungli jaanwaron ki nigrani karna nahi balki unke ilaqe ki hifazat karna bhi tha. Ek khaas ilaqa tha jise hum 'No-Go Zone' kehte the kyunki wahan ka raasta bahut khatarnak aur sunsaan maana jata tha. Is zone mein radio signals aksar gayab ho jaate the aur koi bhi bina zarurat ke wahan nahi jaata tha. Humari team ko us din ek khaas gasht par nikalna tha taaki hum check kar sakein ki monsoon ke baad raste sahi hain ya nahi. Mere liye ye ek mahatvapurn duty thi aur main har cheez ko bahut gambhirta se leta tha. Us waqt mujhe bilkul ehsaas nahi tha ki wo raasta meri zindagi badalne wala hai. Kuch baaten aisi hoti hain jo insaan ko tab tak samajh nahi aati jab tak unhe mehsoos na kiya jaye.

Uss din ki taiyariyan poori ho chuki thi aur humara intezaar khatam hua tha. Mere saath Vikram naam ka ek purana ranger tha jo isi ilaake mein kai saalon se kaam kar raha tha. Usne meri jeep ke saaman ko check kiya aur phir mere chehre par dekha. "Yeh ilaqe mein radio signals aksar gayab ho jaate hain," usne thodi gambhirta se kaha. Maine sirf sar hilaya kyunki mera poora dhyan aane wale raste par tha. Humari gaadi ka engine garaj raha tha jab humne jungle ke gehre hisse mein kadam rakha. Baahar mitti ki ek bhari aur ajeeb mehak thi jo barish ke baad hi aati hai. Har mod par bade ped aise lagte the jaise ve raaste ko block kar rahe hon. Raasta jitna gehra jata gaya, utna hi sannata badhne laga aur hawaon mein thandak aa gayi. Vikram ne apna walkie-talkie check kiya aur phir use band kar diya. Usne kaha, "Yahan se aage sirf hamara hausla aur tumhara dhyan hi kaam aayega." Main us waqt uski baaton ko ek purane senapati ki hidayat samajh raha tha. Mujhe tab bilkul ehsaas nahi tha ki ye shuruat thi kisi aise safar ki jo mere dimaag mein hamesha ke liye bas jayega. Us din ki us khamosh raat ne mujhe chetavni di thi, par main us waqt sirf apni duty par dhayan de raha tha.
summary: This section establishes the transition from the introduction to the narrative, introducing a senior ranger and the tense atmosphere of entering the "No-Go Zone" during a night patrol.
